### What Is Usually Included and Not Included in a Live Cell Therapy, Alternative Medicine Package?

Learn exactly what is included and excluded in alternative medicine packages abroad. Clarify scope on therapy sessions, accommodation, meals, and diagnostic tests.

### ✓ Typically Included

These are the items most patients expect to see inside a standard alternative medicine package abroad. The exact clinic package can still vary, so users should confirm details in writing.
- Initial holistic health assessment
- Personalized alternative treatment plan
- Scheduled therapy sessions
- Prescribed natural or herbal supplements
- Specialized dietary meals (if residential)
- Mind-body wellness activities
- Post-treatment lifestyle coaching

### ✗ Often Not Included

These are the items most patients expect to see inside a standard alternative medicine package abroad. The exact clinic package can still vary, so users should confirm details in writing.
- International flights and transfers
- Hotel accommodation (for outpatient clinics)
- Long-term supplement refills to take home
- Standard allopathic emergency care
- Travel and medical complications insurance
